steps.title: FAQ: Foreign ownership
steps.text: Can foreigners own property in Cambodia? Yes, under 3 rules. 1. From the first floor up, in your own name. The ground floor cannot be in a foreigner's own name. 2. At most 70% of the units in one building can be owned by foreigners (the foreign quota). Check how much is left before you choose. 3. The unit must have a strata title, registered with the national Ministry of Land Management. A soft title is for Cambodian citizens only. Foreigners cannot own land in their own name. Buildings from before 2010, or without a strata licence, cannot give a strata title.
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t: 外国人は不動産を所有できますか？ はい。3つのルールがあります。 1. 地上階（グラウンドフロア）より上の部屋なら、ご本人の名義で所有できます。グラウンドフロアは外国人本人の名義にはできません。 2. 外国人が所有できるのは、1棟の全戸数の70%までです（外国人枠）。購入前に残りの枠を確認します。 3. ストラタタイトル（国の土地管理省に登録される区分所有の権利証）が必要です。ソフトタイトルはカンボジア国民のみが対象です。 土地そのものは、外国人本人の名義では所有できません。2010年以前の建物や、ストラタの許可がない建物では、ストラタタイトルが発行されません。

At most 70% of the units in one building can be owned by foreigners (the foreign quota). Check how much is left before you choose. 3. The unit must have a strata title, registered with the national Ministry of Land Management. A soft title is for Cambodian citizens only. Foreigners cannot own land in their own name. Buildings from before 2010, or without a strata licence, cannot give a strata title.
b: និយាយជាមួយ Nick តាម LINE

steps.title: FAQ: Extra costs
steps.text: What you pay, start to finish Booking fee: usually $500 to $2,000, counted toward the down payment Down payment: 20 to 30% of the price, when you sign the contract (SPA) Transfer tax: 4% of the value (exemptions may apply) Legal and contract review: 0.5 to 1% of the value Furniture and fit-out: varies, often $5,000 to $15,000 After you buy: Yearly property tax: 0.1% of 80% of the value, above the first $25,000 (about $95 a year on a $150,000 unit) Building management: $1 to $2 per sqm a month Some developers pay the transfer tax as a promotion. Nick confirms the exact figures for each project.

steps.title: FAQ: Rental tax and fees
steps.text: Tax and costs on rental income Rental income tax: 14% for owners living abroad, 10% for residents. For overseas owners it is usually deducted before the rent reaches you. Other running costs: building management of $1 to $2 per sqm a month (often about $1.8), and empty months between tenants (plan for about 10% a year). A practical estimate of what you keep: rent, minus the tax, minus building management, minus about 10% for empty months.
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t: 賃貸収入の税金と費用 賃貸収入の税金：海外在住のオーナーは14%、カンボジア居住者は10%です。海外オーナーの場合、通常は家賃が届く前に差し引かれます。 そのほかの費用：建物の管理費（1㎡あたり月1ドルから2ドル、目安は約1.8ドル）と、入居者が入れ替わる間の空室（年に約10%を見込みます）。 手取りの目安は、家賃から税金、建物の管理費、空室分の約10%を引いて計算します。

steps.title: FAQ: How buying works
steps.text: The buying process: 6 steps 1. Booking: choose a unit and pay a booking fee, usually $500 to $2,000, to hold it 2. Down payment and contract (SPA): about 20 to 30% of the price when you sign. Have your own lawyer review the SPA first 3. Instalments during construction: monthly, quarterly or by construction stage (for example 1% a month for 35 months) 4. Balance at handover: the rest, often 40 to 50%, in cash or with a bank loan 5. Handover: inspect the unit, list any defects for the developer, then collect the keys 6. Title registration: once fully paid, the strata title is registered in your name with the Ministry of Land Management (MLMUPC)
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t: 購入の流れ：6つのステップ 1. 予約：部屋を選び、予約金（通常500ドルから2,000ドル）を支払って確保 2. 頭金と売買契約書（SPA）：署名時に価格の約20%から30%。署名前に、ご自身の弁護士による確認をおすすめします 3. 建設中の分割払い：毎月、四半期ごと、または工事の段階ごと（例：月1%を35か月） 4. 引き渡し時の残金：残りの40%から50%程度を、現金または銀行ローンで 5. 引き渡し：完成した部屋を点検し、不具合をデベロッパーに伝えてから鍵を受け取り 6. 権利の登記：全額の支払い後、ストラタタイトルが土地管理省（MLMUPC）でご本人の名義に登記

Balance at handover: the rest, often 40 to 50%, in cash or with a bank loan 5. Handover: inspect the unit, list any defects for the developer, then collect the keys 6. Title registration: once fully paid, the strata title is registered in your name with the Ministry of Land Management (MLMUPC)

steps.title: FAQ: Buying from abroad
steps.text: Can I buy from abroad? Yes. The Sales and Purchase Agreement can be signed digitally or through a notarised power of attorney, so you do not have to be in Cambodia. Purchase prices and rents are almost always in US dollars, so there is no currency exchange step in the deal itself.
steps.note: Facts from the website FAQ. Japanese needs a native review. Khmer shows English for now.

jp.t: 海外から購入できますか？ はい。売買契約書は電子署名、または公証された委任状で締結できるため、現地に来なくても購入できます。 購入価格も家賃も、ほぼすべて米ドルで取引されます。

steps.title: Estimate with my numbers
steps.text: Estimate with my numbers Send two numbers: the price and the monthly rent. You get the gross yield and a net range after tax and the management fee. Example: 68000 650 If you know your yearly costs, add them as a third number: 68000 650 1800 Yields and prices are for reference only and do not guarantee future income.
steps.note: The client types the numbers. The bot supplies no yield figure of its own.

jp.t: ご自身の数値で試算 2つの数字を送ってください。価格と月額家賃です。表面利回りと、税金と管理費を引いた手取りの目安が分かります。 例: 68000 650 年間費用が分かる場合は、3つ目の数字として加えてください。68000 650 1800 ※利回り・価格は参考値であり、将来の収益を保証するものではありません。

kh.t: ប៉ាន់ស្មានតាមលេខរបស់ខ្ញុំ សូមផ្ញើលេខពីរ៖ តម្លៃ និងថ្លៃជួលប្រចាំខែ។ ឧទាហរណ៍: 68000 650 បើអ្នកដឹងចំណាយប្រចាំឆ្នាំ សូមបន្ថែមជាលេខទីបី៖ 68000 650 1800 ផលចំណេញ និងតម្លៃគឺសម្រាប់ជាឯកសារយោងប៉ុណ្ណោះ ហើយមិនធានាប្រាក់ចំណូលនាពេលអនាគតទេ។

steps.title: Privacy and my data
steps.text: Privacy and my data We store your Telegram ID, your language and the answers you give so Nick can help you. We do not sell or share them. You can delete everything at any time.
steps.note: Needs a quick legal read for clients in the EU and Japan.
